variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.rotation: Rotate through the identity runbook; existing sessions require an explicit transition plan.

variables.name: BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Use once, then remove from the runtime environment and manage the account through the identity flow.

variables.name: BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Planned adapter: overlap two short-lived machine-account tokens, verify read access, then revoke the old token.

variables.name: CONNECTOR_KEY_RING
variables.rotation: Add a new active key, re-encrypt and verify, then retire the old key under ADR-0008.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.rotation: Issue a new least-privilege application credential, roll services, verify readiness, then revoke the old credential.

variables.name: E2E_CREDENTIALS_FILE
variables.rotation: Recreated by the E2E seed for an isolated disposable database; delete with the test workspace.

variables.name: E2E_OWNER_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Generate per isolated E2E environment and discard with its database and credentials file.

variables.name: GH_TOKEN
variables.rotation: GitHub issues the job-scoped token; never persist it beyond the workflow job.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.rotation: GitHub issues the job-scoped token with workflow permissions; never copy it into Control Hub.

variables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.rotation: Overlap provider secrets when supported, verify an OAuth exchange, then revoke the previous secret.

variables.name: MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.rotation: Overlap provider secrets when supported, verify an OAuth exchange, then revoke the previous secret.

variables.name: MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
variables.rotation: Inject only for the migration job and remove when it completes; rotate the database credential after exposure.

variables.name: POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Rotate through PostgreSQL administration, verify migration access, and revoke the old password.

variables.name: POSTGRES_APP_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Create a replacement application credential, roll consumers, verify readiness, then revoke the old password.

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.rotation: When authentication is configured, roll a replacement credential across API and worker before revocation.

variables.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Use a scoped source-map upload token in CI and revoke or replace it from Sentry without changing runtime.

variables.name: TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL
variables.rotation: Generate for the isolated test database and discard with the test environment.

variables.name: TEST_DATABASE_URL
variables.rotation: Generate for the isolated test database and discard with the test environment.
